record.title: Evaluate the display export and RF preparation implications
record.intent: Decide the next measurement preparation from the actual waveform and its limits.
requirements: Evaluate the export and source-shape evidence without claiming raw ADC samples, calibrated spectral purity or 1 GHz response.
Reconcile the result with the existing inventory and RF comparison preparation. Identify the next smallest uncertainty; no additional physical operation occurs in this decision.
Commit and push the conclusion and keep the completed run immutable.
acceptance: A scoped result and next preparation question follow from retained evidence.
